subject: Private deployment economics & licensing options — follow-up
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Aarti Shah <aarti.shah@brightedge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0400
Subject: Private deployment economics & licensing options — follow-up

Hi Aarti — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and so Marissa/Ben can weight in on pricing and next steps.

Notes from call (brief):
- Workload: high-throughput extraction + summarization for enterprise search (batched embedding + streaming generation paths).
- Current infra: on-prem H100s in two regions (primary + DR), ~8 GPUs total initially, planning to expand to 16 over next 12 months.
- Estimated daily tokens (inference output + input): 150–300M tokens/day during peak; 50–80M tokens/day baseline.
- Environments requested: dev/staging/prod, plus a DR region; prod needs SLA and private VPC control plane.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 in-scope, customer-managed KMS required.

Aarti, you mentioned a target unit economics in the $700–$1,200 per 1M tokens range depending on commitment and support SLAs. Can you confirm the target $/1M you want us to design around? Also, confirm whether the 8->16 GPU growth is firm for the first year or just a high-level plan — that impacts license sizing.

Marissa/Ben — based on the above, could you sketch 2 license + support options:
1) Baseline: annual private license (per-environment slab + per-1M-token metering) with Standard support (business hours) and 30-day rolling burst capacity; and
2) Premium: larger commit, per-1M-token discount, 24x7 support, on-call SLA and guaranteed warm standby for DR.

I’ve attached the usage estimate Aarti shared and a pricing strawman (Redwood_Private_Pricing_v2.pdf).

Next steps / asks:
- Aarti: confirm target $/1M tokens and confirm environment count (dev/staging/prod/DR).
- Internal: Marissa to provide high-level sticker prices for both options + an example economics table (token tiers).
- I’ll schedule a short follow-up next week to review alternatives and align on procurement timeline.

Thanks,

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 617-555-0183
From: Aarti Shah <aarti.shah@brightedge.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightEdge Engineering <eng+procurement@brightedge.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 17:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment economics & licensing options — follow-up

Sean — thanks for the recap, that’s accurate and helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

- Token volumes: the 150–300M/day peak is the right ballpark. For contracting we’d want to budget for an average of ~80–100M/day and a separate burst pool for peak. For year-1 sizing, assume 8 GPUs steady with a plan to evaluate scaling to 12 GPUs in Q4.
- Target pricing: our procurement team prefers to target <= $850 per 1M tokens for committed volume, but we can stretch to $1,000/1M if there is a meaningful enterprise discount tied to a multi-year commitment or dedicated capacity guarantees.
- Environments: dev (non-prod), staging (shared), prod (private VPC), DR (cold standby). We expect 3 distinct RDW deployments (dev/staging/prod) and a DR config that can be warmed within a week.
- Support: Standard support during business hours is acceptable for POC and initial rollout; we expect to upgrade to Premium (24x7) before global launch.

Attachments: I re-uploaded the usage estimate workbook with month-by-month expected token ramp (BrightEdge-usage-estimate.xlsx).

Happy to review your pricing options next week — Tue or Wed mornings (ET) work best.

Best,
Aarti
Aarti Shah
Head of NLP Platform, BrightEdge
aarti.shah@brightedge.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aarti Shah <aarti.shah@brightedge.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment economics & licensing options — follow-up

Aarti / Sean — looping in Ben for support tier sizing. Thanks Aarti for the spend target — that’s useful. Below are two distinct commercial pathways we can present; both assume private VPC deployment with SOC2 controls and customer-managed KMS.

Option A — Consumption-first (lower TCO to start)
- Setup: one-time private deployment fee (covers automation, onboarding, SOC evidence handover).
- Environments: priced per-environment (dev/staging/prod) — dev free for 3 months; staging and prod each carry a small environment license.
- Token pricing: $975 per 1M tokens for month-to-month consumption; reduction to $850/1M with a 12-month volume commit (committed monthly baseline).
- Support: Standard (business hours) included; Premium is an add-on.
- GPU/instance note: optional dedicated GPU reservation add-on priced per-GPU/month if you want capacity isolation.

Option B — Commitment + SLA (better unit economics)
- Setup: reduced one-time fee with a 12–24 month term commitment.
- Environments: bundled (prod+staging) in the commitment; dev is still treated as non-billable for first 6 months.
- Token pricing: $700 per 1M tokens at higher committed volume threshold (12M tokens/month minimum); otherwise $950/1M fallback.
- Support: Premium included for the term (24x7, SLA-backed).
- DR: Warm standby included (limited warm capacity for failover within SLA window).

A couple of operational notes:
- If BrightEdge wants cold DR only (warm within a week), we can reduce the price delta on Option B — we’ll show both DR flavors in the worksheet.
- We’ll produce a short table showing effective $/1M at the 80/100/150M avg/day tiers so you can see sensitivity to token ramp.

Ben — can you add a second tab to the pricing PDF that shows an example invoice: baseline month, committed discount applied, and one-off onboarding amortized? Sean — I’ll need the procurement timeline and any PO constraints from BrightEdge so we can align contract language (termination windows, indemnities).

I’ll convert this into a concise PDF (pricing + two example economics tables) and send before our call.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial Pricing, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Aarti Shah <aarti.shah@brightedge.ai>

Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment economics & licensing options — follow-up

Marissa — this looks good and gives us the flexibility we wanted. Quick confirmations:
- We’ll aim for Option B if the $700/1M committed level is achievable with the included warm-DR and Premium support; otherwise Option A with the 12-month commit at $850/1M is acceptable.
- Procurement timeline: we’re targeting an internal approval decision by end of Q3; will expect a formal proposal/term sheet to circulate in July.

I can do Tue 8 Jun 10:00 AM ET for the follow-up call — Sean, can you send the invite?

Thanks,
Aarti
